subject: Discovery recap + RSVP: POC environment prep and scheduling

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + RSVP: POC environment prep and scheduling

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet today, and thanks for walking through PacificCare's goals and constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical walkthrough: 

What we covered (short):
- Use case: real-time chart summarization + contextual search over 2 years of clinical notes.
- Primary constraints: PII redaction pipeline, on-prem data connectors, and sub-100ms median token latency for short queries.
- Success metric for POC: 90% of sampled prompts within target latency and no PHI leakage in outputs per our test harness.

Next steps (action items):
1) Technical walkthrough (30–45 min) where we show a quick run of the model on a sanitized dataset and confirm integration points.
2) Exchange environment prerequisites (keys, test dataset sample, network access) ahead of the session.

Proposed time windows (all in PDT; I included equivalent EDT and CET notes if useful):
- Tue May 11, 09:00–09:45 PDT (12:00–12:45 EDT)
- Wed May 12, 10:00–10:45 PDT (13:00–13:45 EDT) — our preferred slot
- Thu May 13, 15:00–15:45 PDT (18:00–18:45 EDT)

Can you confirm which of those works and who from your engineering/security side will join? Also let us know if you prefer Google Meet or Zoom; we can send the calendar invite once times/attendees are confirmed. 

I've attached a short POC environment checklist for your ops team — items in bold are required before the walkthrough. If your security team needs a SOC2 snapshot or additional compliance notes, I can loop in our Security Engineer ahead of the meeting.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: poc-env-checklist.pdf

Thanks — see you next week.
